entries.00daa56551cb77da: Nissui Corporation is the center of a group whose main contents are the Marine Products Business, the Food Business, the Fine Business, and the Logistics Business. The group consists of the company, 71 [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]], and 27 [[term:affiliate|affiliates]], and also develops research and services related to each business. Its mission is to solve social issues by pursuing new possibilities for "food" in response to changes in the times and the environment, drawing on the resource access capabilities, research and development capabilities, production technology, and quality assurance capabilities it has cultivated over more than 110 years, and on a value chain consisting of global links and local links spread across countries around the world. As of March 31, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 11,526.

entries.44e4e55f8c279594: What it provides is divided into 4 [[term:segment|reporting segments]]. The Marine Products Business consists of the fishing business, which catches fish by boat, the aquaculture business, which raises fish, and the processing and trading business, which processes and sells marine products, and it handles the catching of yellowtail, horse mackerel, and mackerel, the farming of bluefin tuna and coho salmon, and the sale of Alaska pollock fillets and surimi, and of cod, salmon and trout, and crab. The Food Business consists of the processing business, which makes frozen foods for household and commercial use and chikuwa and fish sausages, and the chilled business, which makes boxed meals and prepared dishes. The Fine Business consists of pharmaceutical raw materials, functional raw materials such as EPA and DHA used as raw materials for supplements and as materials added to infant formula, and functional foods such as the mail-order food with functional claims "Minna no Mikata DHA with Sesame Soy Milk" and the food for specified health uses "Imark S." The Logistics Business handles refrigerated warehouses, delivery, and customs clearance. In Other, which is not included in the reporting segments, it engages in shipbuilding and repair, operation, engineering, and other activities.
